findings.description: CI Pipeline workflow startup_failure: undefined inputs validate-docker-compose, validate-jcasc, validate-k8s passed to reusable-build.yml
CI workflow pre-commit failure: markdownlint and prettier violations in design.md, plan.md, specification.md
Preflight commit-format gate: 3 PR commits did not follow Conventional Commits format
Preflight .env.example secret detection: POSTGRES_PASSWORD had non-placeholder value
Docker Compose tests fail: backstage/backstage:latest image not accessible in CI environment
.env not available in CI for Docker Compose (FIXED by adding cp .env.example .env step)

decision: Fixed CI Pipeline startup_failure (removed undefined inputs), fixed pre-commit formatting (markdown+prettier), fixed commit format (rebase), fixed .env.example secret check (placeholder value), added .env setup for tests. Pre-existing Docker Compose test infra issue requires architectural decision.
blockers: Docker Compose test infrastructure requires architectural decision: backstage/backstage:latest image not publicly accessible. Options: add Docker Compose profiles, CI-specific compose override, replace with public image, or redesign tests.
